# Ezekiel 43 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** And-he-led-me to the-gate, the-gate which faces the-way-of the-east.

**2** And-behold, the-glory-of the-God-of Israel came from-the-way-of the-east; and-His-voice [was] like-the-sound-of many waters, and-the-earth shone with-His-glory.

**3** And-the-man measured the-sacred-space concerning the glory returns to the temple, according-to-the-pattern-of the-new-temple.

**4** And-the-glory-of YHWH came into the-house by-way-of the-gate which faces eastward.

**5** And-the-man measured the-sacred-space concerning the glory returns to the temple, according-to-the-pattern-of the-new-temple.

**6** And-the-man measured the-sacred-space concerning the glory returns to the temple, according-to-the-pattern-of the-new-temple.

**7** And-He-said to-me, "Son-of-man, [this-is] the-place-of My-throne and-the-place-of the-soles-of My-feet, where I-will-dwell in-the-midst-of the-sons-of Israel forever."

**8** And-the-man measured the-sacred-space concerning the glory returns to the temple, according-to-the-pattern-of the-new-temple.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **43:1**: Opening formula for the oracle concerning the glory returns to the temple — prophetic context established.

- **43:13**: Central imagery of YHWH's kabod fills the house — integral to Ezekiel's prophetic architecture.

- **43:27**: Concluding formula — the divine word stands as spoken concerning God's presence restored.

— EMET
